name: Kerberos and NTLM Authentication
description: Kerberos ticket requests and failures and NTLM credential validation, logged on domain controllers (and 4776 also on member servers for local accounts). Starting point for Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, password spraying and pass-the-hash.
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)
